SCRIPT.KOREAN: 아, 중대장 님... 참 좋은 분이셨죠.
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Ah, Captain... he really was a good guy.

SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 啊，中隊長啊...他真是個好人啊
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: ああ、中隊長…ほんといい人でしたね
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Ah, Kapten… dia emang orang baik, ya.

SCRIPT.SPANISH: Ah, el comandante… era una buena persona.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: آه، کاپیتان... او واقعاً پسر خوبی بود.

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Well, except for the hair situation.

SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Embora... faltasse um pouco de cabelo.

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: In our Dragon Fire unit, we used to call him the Bald Eagle.

SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 俺らドラゴンファイアの中じゃハゲタカって呼んでました
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Di unit Dragon Fire, kita dulu manggil dia si Elang Botak.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Na nossa unidade, chamávamos ele de “Águia Careca”.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Dentro de nuestro unidad, lo llamábamos el águila calva.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: در واحد آتش اژدها، ما اونو عقاب طاس صدا می کردیم.

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Man, pretending to believe you is exhausting.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 啊，要装傻听你胡扯也太累了
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 要配合你演下去也真不容易
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: はあ…騙されきれないな
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Astaga, pura-pura percaya omongan kamu tuh capek banget, tahu.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Qué dificil es seguirte la corriente.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: مرد، تظاهر به باور شما خسته کننده است.

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: His hair was plenty full, thank you very much.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 中队长可是一头浓密秀发
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 中隊長、髪はふさふさだ
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Rambutnya tuh lebat banget, makasih ya.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: O comandante tinha uma cabeleira cheia!

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 별명이 붉은 머리의 사자였다고. 이게 어디서 거짓말이야!
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: They used to call him the Red-Maned Lion, for god’s sake. Don’t go making stuff up!

SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 他的外號可是紅髮獅子欸！你是在說謊嗎！
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: あだ名は赤髪のライオンだったんだよ どこでそんな嘘ついてんだ！
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Dulu malah dipanggil Singa Berjambul Merah, sumpah. Jangan asal ngarang, deh!
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: E o apelido dele era “Leão de Juba Vermelha”! Como pode mentir assim?!
SCRIPT.SPANISH: y su apodo era “el león de melena roja”. ¡¿Cómo se te ocurre mentir así?!
